label: theorem:harmonic-balls
content: A.s., for every z in C there is a unique family {Lambda_t(z)}_{t>0} of harmonic balls (eq:harmonic-ball with test class eq:harmonic-fns) such that mu_h(Lambda_t(z))=t, mu_h(boundary Lambda_t(z))=0, Lambda_t(z)=int(closure Lambda_t(z)), bounded, connected, containing z, increasing continuously in t in the Hausdorff topology, and cap_{t>0} Lambda_t(z)={z}.

label: theorem:harmonic-balls-properties
content: A.s., for Lebesgue-a.e. t, Lambda_t(0) is neither a Lipschitz domain nor a D_h-metric ball; for every t>0 the boundary of each connected component of C minus closure(Lambda_t(0)) is a Jordan curve.

label: prop:locally-determined
content: For fixed t (printed t>=0; drafted t>=0 with closure Lambda_0(x) read as {x}, E21) and x in C, closure(Lambda_t(x)) is a local set of h: for each deterministic open U the event {closure(Lambda_t(x)) subset U} is sigma(h|_U)-measurable.

label: fact:lqg-measure
kind: cited:Duplantier-Sheffield 2011 Prop 2.1 and Sheffield-Wang 2016 (conformal covariance); I-III from the limit eq:measure-lim
content: mu_h is a.s. a non-atomic Radon measure; locality (mu_h(U) is a measurable function of h|_U); Weyl scaling e^{gamma f} mu_h = mu_{h+f} for all continuous f; conformal covariance mu_{h o phi + Q log|phi'|}(A) = mu_h(phi(A)) for all conformal phi simultaneously.

label: fact:lqg-metric
kind: cited:Ding-Dubedat-Dunlap-Falconet 2020, Dubedat-Falconet-Gwynne-Pfeffer-Sun 2020, Gwynne-Miller 2021 (no theorem numbers printed)
content: D_h a.s. induces the Euclidean topology and is a length metric; locality of the internal metric D_h(.,.;U); Weyl scaling with xi=gamma/d_gamma; coordinate change D_h(ru+z,rv+z)=D_{h(r.+z)+Q log r}(u,v).

label: prop:green-properties
content: For x in B_R: Delta G_{B_R}(x,.) = -delta_x on B_R, G_{B_R}(x,.)>0 on B_R, G_{B_R}(x,.)=0 on boundary B_R, and G_{B_R}(x,.) is smooth away from x.

label: lemma:volume-growth
kind: cited:Berestycki-Gwynne 2020 Lemma A.1 (argument adapted, no printed proof of eq:ball-volume); eq:ann-volume derived in the paper
content: For beta+ in (0,(2-gamma)^2/2) and beta- > (2+gamma)^2/2, with polynomially high probability as eps->0: eps^{beta-} <= mu_h(B_eps(z)) <= eps^{beta+} for all z in B_1, and C_2 eps^{beta-} <= mu_h(A_{r1 eps,r2 eps}(z)) <= C_1 eps^{beta+}. Printed range FALSE at z=0 when alpha0>2 or alpha0<-2 (see GRAPH).

label: prop:lbm-exit-time
kind: paper-owned (proof sketch: Campanato embedding, Ponce 2016 Sec 16.2 / remark after Prop 13.5)
content: A.s., for smooth bounded open O and f in L^infty, q(x)=int_O G_O(x,y) f(y) mu_h(dy) (e.g. the expected exit time of LBM from O) is finite and Holder continuous on closure(O).

label: prop:lbm-continuity
kind: cited:Kigami 2019 Thm 13.1 (input Lemma 2.4; scaling from the unit square)
content: For a square K, a.s. the heat kernel p^K_t(x,y) of gamma-LBM reflected in K exists, is finite, jointly continuous and strictly positive on (0,inf) x K x K (kernel w.r.t. mu_h|_K; printed dy at line 547).

label: lemma:basic-properties
kind: paper-owned (proved in App A: Lemma A.1)
content: A.s., for all t,r>0 and z in B_r, the least supersolution lambda^{B_r;z}_t (eq:least-super-solution) is finite, continuous and belongs to S^{B_r;z}_t (eq:super-solutions).

label: lemma:non-coincidence-open-harmonic
kind: paper-owned (proved in App A: Lemmas A.1-A.2; nu>=0 not proved)
content: A.s., for all t,r>0, z in B_r: the cluster Lambda^{B_r;z}_t is open and connected and Delta lambda^{B_r;z}_t = mu_h|_Lambda + nu|_{boundary Lambda} on B_r with nu Radon, 0<=nu<=mu_h; hence Delta v^{B_r;z}_t = -t delta_z + mu_h|_Lambda + nu|_{boundary Lambda}.

label: lemma:monotonicity
kind: paper-owned (proved in App A: Lemma A.3)
content: A.s., for all t1<=t2, r>0 and z in B_r: Lambda^{B_r;z}_{t1} subset Lambda^{B_r;z}_{t2}.

label: lemma:conservation-of-mass
kind: paper-owned (proved in App A: Lemmas A.4-A.5)
content: A.s., for all r,t>0 and z in B_r: mu_h(Lambda^{B_r;z}_t) <= t and v^{B_r;z}_t = 0 on boundary B_r; if closure(Lambda^{B_r;z}_t) subset B_r and mu_h(boundary Lambda^{B_r;z}_t)=0 then mu_h(Lambda^{B_r;z}_t)=t.

label: lemma:cluster-compatibility
kind: paper-owned (proved in App A: Lemma A.6)
content: For each R>0, a.s.: for all t>0, s1<=R, z in B_{s1}, if closure(Lambda^{B_{s2};z}_t) subset B_{s1} for some s2 in [s1,R], then Lambda^{B_s;z}_t = Lambda^{B_{s2};z}_t for all s in [s1,R].

label: prop:lower-bound
content: A.s., for each t>0 and z in B_1: B_eps(z) subset Lambda^z_t for some random eps=eps(t,z)>0; for each delta in (|z|,1) there is t(delta) with B_{1-delta}(z) subset Lambda^z_t for t>=t(delta); there is t^+ with closure(Lambda^z_t) meeting boundary B_1 for all t>=t^+.

label: odometer:cont
content: There is a deterministic exponent alpha=alpha(gamma) (should be alpha(gamma,alpha0)) such that a.s. there is C with |lambda^z_t(x)-lambda^z_t(y)| <= C|x-y|^alpha for all t>0, z in B_1, x,y in B_1.

label: lemma:harmonic-ball
content: A.s., for all r,t>0 and z in B_r: if closure(Lambda^{B_r;z}_t) subset B_r and mu_h(boundary Lambda^{B_r;z}_t)=0, then Lambda^{B_r;z}_t is a subharmonic ball centred at z (eq:subharmonic-ball, eq:sub-harmonic-potential).

label: prop:upper-bound
kind: paper-owned (proved in Sec 7, line 2101, from Prop 7.1)
content: A.s. there is a random T=T(gamma,h)>0 such that closure(Lambda^z_t) subset B_1 for all z in B_{1/2} and 0<t<T.

label: prop:continuity
kind: paper-owned (proved in Sec 7, line 2101, from Props 7.1, 7.2)
content: A.s., for all z in B_{1/2}: cap_{t>0} closure(Lambda^z_t) = {z}, and for each t>0 and small eps>0 there is delta(z)>0 with closure(Lambda^z_{t'}) subset Lambda^z_t + B_eps for t' in [t,t+delta] (printed '+ B_eps(z)').

label: prop:boundary-measure
content: A.s., mu_h(boundary Lambda^z_t) = 0 for all z in B_1 and t>0 with closure(Lambda^z_t) subset B_1 (printed 'subset B_r(z)' with r free).

label: prop:conditional
content: A.s., for all z in B_{1/2} (printed also 'for all r>0', unused), the regularized clusters int(closure(Lambda^z_t)) (eq:regular-cluster), 0<t<T, are contained in B_1, satisfy the conditions of Thm 1.1, and closure(int(closure(Lambda^z_T))) meets boundary B_1; T unbound (see GRAPH).

label: theorem:full-theorem-minus-uniqueness
content: A.s., for all z in C there is a family {Lambda-hat_t(z)}_{t>0} satisfying the conditions of Thm 1.1, each a subharmonic ball, and Lambda-hat_t(z) = int(closure(Lambda^{B_r;z}_t)) for all r>=s whenever Lambda-hat_t(z) Subset B_s.

label: prop:uniqueness
content: A.s., if for some z in C a family {A_t(z)}_{t>0} of harmonic balls satisfies the conditions of Thm 1.1, then A_t(z) = Lambda-hat_t(z) for all t>0.

label: lemma:scale-invariance-flow
content: For k>0 and z in B_1, {Lambda^z_t}_{t>0} and {k^{-1} Lambda^{B_k;kz}_{A_k t}}_{t>0} have the same law, where A_k = exp(gamma(Q log k + h_k(0))).

label: lemma:strong-compatibility
content: For a deterministic bounded open U, a.s. for all t>0 and z in C: closure(Lambda-hat_t(z)) = closure(Lambda^{U;z}_t) if Lambda-hat_t(z) Subset U or Lambda^{U;z}_t Subset U.

label: prop:harnack-type-property
content: There are alpha(gamma)>0 and events E-bar_rho(x0) such that for z in B_1: if E-bar_rho(x0) occurs, closure(B_rho(x0)) subset B_1\{z} and mu_h(Lambda^z_t cap A_{rho/2,rho}(x0)) <= alpha mu_h(A_{rho/2,rho}(x0)), then Lambda^z_t misses B_{rho/2}(x0); w.p.h.p. as eps->0 each x0 in the eps/100-lattice of B_{1+eps}\B_{10 sqrt eps} has >= c log eps^{-1/2} radii rho in [eps,eps^{1/2}] cap {8^{-n}} with E-bar_rho(x0).

label: prop:harnack-type-stronger-property
kind: paper-owned (with Prop 6.1 proved at line 1593 from Lemmas 6.6, 6.11)
content: In the setting of Prop 6.1, for a connected component tilde-Lambda of Lambda^z_t cap B_rho(x0): if mu_h(tilde-Lambda cap A_{rho/2,rho}(x0)) <= alpha mu_h(A_{rho/2,rho}(x0)) then tilde-Lambda misses closure(B_{rho/2}(x0)).

label: lemma:good-annuli
content: For b in (0,1) there are a(b,gamma)>0 and universal c>0 such that w.p.h.p. as eps->0 every z in (B_{1+eps}\B_{10 sqrt eps}) cap (eps/100)Z^2 has >= c log_7 eps^{-1/2} radii r in [eps,eps^{1/2}] cap {7^{-n}} for which E_r(z;a,b) (eq:good-annulus-harmonic) occurs.

label: lemma:annulus-hit
content: For b,p in (0,1) there is a(b,p,gamma) in (0,1) with P[E_r(z;a,b)] >= p for all r>0 and all z with dist(A_{3r,5r}(z),{0}) >= r/100.

label: lemma:annulus-iterate
kind: cited:Gwynne-Miller 2020 (Local metrics of the GFF, Ann. Inst. Fourier 70), Lemma 3.1 (printed at line 1259: [Lemma 3.1]{gwynne2020local}; Lemma 6.5 is a special case)
content: For 0<s1<s2<1, radii with r_{k+1}/r_k <= s1 and events E_{r_k} measurable w.r.t. h|_{A_{s1 r_k,s2 r_k}(0)} modulo additive constant: for alpha>0, beta in (0,1) there are p,C (depending on alpha,beta,s1,s2) such that P[E_{r_k}]>=p for all k implies P[N(K) < beta K] <= C e^{-alpha K} for all K.

label: lemma:very-good-annuli
content: For b in (0,1) there are a(b,gamma), universal c,C_3, C_1^pm,C_2^pm (depending on a,gamma) and N_1(b,gamma) such that for N_0>=N_1, w.p.h.p. as eps->0 every x0 in the eps/100-lattice of B_{1+eps}\B_{10 sqrt eps} has >= c log_8 eps^{-1/2} radii rho in [eps,eps^{1/2}] cap {8^{-n}} with E-bar_rho(x0).

label: lemma:very-good-annuli-hit
content: For b,p in (0,1) there are a(b,p,gamma), C_1^pm,C_2^pm and universal C_3 such that P[E-bar_rho(x0)] >= p for all rho>0 and x0 with dist(A_{rho/4,2rho}(x0),{0}) >= rho/100, for all N_0>=N_1.

label: lemma:odometer-annuli
content: For 0<s1<s2<s3<s4, z in B_1, an annulus A_{s1 r,s4 r}(w) subset B_1 not containing z and hat-Lambda a union of components of A_{s1 r,s4 r}(w) cap Lambda^z_t: mu_h(A_{s2 r,s3 r}(w) cap hat-Lambda) <= C(s1..s4) sup_{hat-Lambda} v^z_t.

label: lemma:harmonic-odometer-comparison
content: For z in B_1, open A subset B_1 not containing z and x in A cap Lambda^z_t: v^z_t(x) <= (sup of v^z_t over boundary(A) cap closure(Lambda^x_t)) * P[Brownian motion from x exits A before hitting A\Lambda^x_t | h], Lambda^x_t the component of A cap Lambda^z_t containing x.

label: lemma:odometer-bound-lqg-mass
content: For 0<s1<s2<s3<s4 there is c(s1..s4) with sup_{A_{s2 rho,s3 rho}(x0)} v^z_t <= c S_rho(x0;s1,s4) (eq:alternate-size-2-full) for all z in B_1 and annuli A_{s1 rho,s4 rho}(x0) subset B_1\{z} with complement of Lambda^z_t meeting A_{s2 rho,s3 rho}(x0).

label: lemma:very-good-annuli-satisfy-harnack-type-estimate
content: For every C_3>0 there is b(gamma,C_3) [G18; printed: there are universal C_3 and b(gamma)] such that for every z in B_1, C_1^pm, C_2^pm, a there are N_1 and alpha(a,N_0,gamma,C_1^-) with: if closure(B_rho(x0)) subset B_1\{z}, E-bar_rho(x0) occurs and a component tilde-Lambda of Lambda^z_t cap B_rho(x0) has mu_h(tilde-Lambda cap A_{rho/2,rho}) <= alpha mu_h(A_{rho/2,rho}), then tilde-Lambda misses closure(B_{rho/2}(x0)).

label: lemma:shell-decomposition
content: Shells S_j = boundary B_{d_j}(x0) + B_{l_j}, l_j = rho 2^{-j/4} 2^{-50}, d_0 = 3rho/4, d_j = d_{j-1} - 32 l_{j-1}: for N_0>=200 the fattened shells S_j+B_{8 l_j} lie in A_{rho/2,rho}(x0), are mutually separated, and B_{8 eps_j^{1/2} rho}(z) subset A_{rho/2,d_j^+}(x0) for z in S_j (eps_j=2^{-(N_0+j)}, d_j^+=d_j+8 l_j).

label: lemma:low-mass-implies-small-odometer
content: If criterion (iii) of a very good annulus holds for A_{rho/2,rho}(x0) with closure(B_rho(x0)) subset B_1\{z} [C15; printed: not containing z] and tilde-Lambda is a component of Lambda^z_t cap B_rho(x0): if every annulus A_{r,7r}(z') in A_{rho/2,d_j^+}(x0) has mu_h(tilde-Lambda cap A_{3r,5r}(z')) <= K_j = a M_rho(x0) eps_j^{beta-}, then sup over tilde-Lambda cap A_{rho/2,d_{j+1}^+} of v <= b^{C' C_3 (N_0+j)} times the sup over tilde-Lambda cap A_{rho/2,d_j^+}.

label: prop:upper-bound-polynomially-high-prob
content: For each r in (0,1), w.p.h.p. as T->0: closure(Lambda^z_t) subset B_{r/2}(z) for all t<=T and all z in B_{1/2}.

label: prop:continuity-of-clusters
content: A.s., for each t>0 and z in B_1 with Lambda^z_t Subset B_1, for all small eps>0 (depending on t): Lambda^z_{t+eps} Subset Lambda^z_t + B_delta (printed B_delta(z)) with delta = C(beta-) eps^{1/(4 beta-)}, beta- from Lemma 2.4.

label: prop:boundary-measure-zero
content: A.s., mu_h(boundary Lambda^z_t) = 0 for all t>0 and z in B_1 with Lambda^z_t Subset B_1.

label: lemma:mu_h-doubling-and-harnack
content: For zeta>0, b in (0,1) there are m>0 and parameters of E-bar_rho such that a.s., for mu_h-a.e. z in B_1 and all large N: #{n in [N+1,2N]: E-bar_n(z) and G_n(z) occur} >= (1-zeta)N (eq:mu_h-doubling).

label: lemma:doubling-alpha
content: For zeta>0, b in (0,1) there are m>0 and parameters of E-bar_rho(0) such that a.s. eq:mu_h-doubling holds at z=0 for all large N.

label: lemma:obstacle-comp
kind: cited:Shahgholian-Sjodin 2013 Thm 2.1; Sakai 1984 (a complete proof is printed)
content: For R>0, z in B_R and a domain A Subset B_R containing z, let f = mu_h(A) G_{B_R}(.,z) - int_A G_{B_R}(.,y) mu_h(dy): if A is a subharmonic ball centred at z then f>=0 on B_R; if A is a harmonic ball centred at z then f=0 on B_R\A.

label: prop:sub-harmonic-ball-uniqueness
content: A.s., if A Subset B_R is a subharmonic ball centred at z in B_R with mu_h(A)=t, then int(closure(Lambda^{B_R;z}_t)) subset A and mu_h(A minus it)=0. Printed conclusion not established by the proof (see GRAPH); unused in the paper.

label: lemma:contains-boundary
content: A.s., every harmonic ball A Subset B_R centred at z in B_R with t=mu_h(A)>0 satisfies boundary(A) subset closure(Lambda-hat_t(z)).

label: lemma:regular-open-ae
content: A.s., if X,Y are open with int(closure X)=X, int(closure Y)=Y and mu_h(X\Y)=mu_h(Y\X)=0, then X=Y.

label: lemma:cannot-cross
content: A.s., for small eps>0 and each w in B_1\B_{20 sqrt eps} there is rho in [eps,eps^{1/2}] such that for all t>0 and z with Lambda_t(z) Subset B_1, at most K=ceil(1/alpha) components of Lambda_t(z) cap B_{2rho}(w) have closures meeting both boundary B_{rho/3}(w) and boundary B_{2rho}(w) (alpha from Prop 6.2).

label: lemma:crossing-connected
content: For an annulus A Subset B_1, t>0, z in B_1 with Lambda_t(z) Subset B_1 and U a simply connected component of the complement of closure(Lambda_t(z)) with boundary Gamma Subset B_1: every component of U^c cap A crossing A contains a component of Lambda_t(z) cap A crossing A.

label: prop:boundary-simple-loop
content: A.s., for all t>0 and z in B_1 with Lambda_t(z) Subset B_1, each connected component of B_1 \ closure(Lambda_t(z)) has boundary a simple loop.

label: prop:boundary-simple-loop-full-cluster
content: A.s., for all t>0 and z in C, each connected component of C \ closure(Lambda-hat_t(z)) has boundary a simple loop.

label: def:lipschitz
content: Lipschitz domain: a non-empty connected open set which near every boundary point is, after rotating axes, the region above the graph of a Lipschitz function.

label: prop:not-balls

label: lemma:no-exterior-cone-condition
content: A.s., for mu_h-a.e. z in C: if t>0 and z in boundary Lambda-hat_t, then Lambda-hat_t does not satisfy the cone condition at z.

label: lemma:harmonic-comparison-chain
content: Universal C: for r>0 and z with 0 not in closure(B_{10r}(z)), if A_{4r,5r}(z) meets the complement of Lambda-hat_t then mu_h(A_{r,2r}(z) cap Lambda-hat_t) <= C S_{3r,6r}(z) (eq:alternate-size-2).

label: lemma:mu_h-bad-and-harnack
content: For a cone Q and M>0 there is delta(M) in (0,1) such that a.s., for mu_h-a.e. z in C and large N: #{n in [N+1,2N]: G~_n(z;M,Q) occurs} >= delta N.

label: lemma:positive-probability
content: For a cone Q and M>0 there is p_M in (0,1) with P[G~_n(z;M,Q)] >= p_M for all z with dist(A_{2^{-n},6*2^{-n}}(z),{0}) > 2^{-n}/100 and n >= N(z).

label: prop:mass-diam-gen
content: For bounded connected open U subset V subset W, closure V subset W, W disjoint from the unit circle, and C>eps>0: with positive probability sup_{u,v in V} D_h(u,v;W) <= eps and mu_h(U) >= C.

label: lemma:mass-diam
content: For closed dyadic squares S1 subset S2 with S2 disjoint from the unit circle and C>eps>0: with positive probability sup_{u,v in S2} D_h(u,v;S2) <= eps and mu_h(S1) >= C.

label: prop:not-metric-balls
content: A.s., Lambda-hat_t (centred at 0) is not an LQG-metric ball for Lebesgue-a.e. t>0.

label: lemma:mu_h-pinch-positive-probability
content: In the case alpha0=0: P[G~_1(0)] > 0 (pinch event of Section 11.3).

label: lemma:mu_h-pinch-bad
content: For M>0 there is delta in (0,1) such that a.s., for mu_h-a.e. z in C and large N: #{n in [N+1,2N]: G^_n(z;M) occurs} >= delta N.

label: lemma:geometric-event-consequence
content: A.s., for each M>0, z in C, r>0 with 0 not in B_{10r}(z): if G^_r(z) occurs, u>0 and z in boundary of the D_h-ball B_u(0;D_h), then Q'_r(z) subset complement of B_u(0;D_h) and T_r(z) subset B_u(0;D_h).

label: lemma:second-event-proof
content: For each M>0, P[E~_1 cap E~_2(M)] > 0.

label: lemma:appendix-basic-properties
content: For a Radon measure mu with eq:volume-growth on B_1 and t>0: the least superharmonic majorant s~_t of the obstacle beta_t = -t G_{B_1}(0,.) + q_{B_1} (eq:obstacle) is finite, continuous and lies in S~_t (eq:shifted-supersolutions).

label: lemma:appendix-non-coincedence-open-harmonic
content: The non-coincidence set Lambda_t = {x in B_1: s~_t(x) > beta_t(x)} is open and connected and s~_t is harmonic on Lambda_t.

label: lemma:appendix-monotonicity
content: If t1<=t2 then Lambda_{t1} subset Lambda_{t2} (via v_{t1} <= v_{t2}).

label: lemma:appendix-zero-boundary
content: For t>0 the odometer v_t = s~_t - beta_t vanishes on boundary B_1.

label: lemma:appendix-conservation-of-mass
content: For t>0, mu(Lambda_t) <= t; if closure(Lambda_t) subset B_1 and mu(boundary Lambda_t)=0 then mu(Lambda_t)=t (printed mu_h).

label: lemma:appendix-cluster-compatibility
content: If eq:volume-growth holds on B_R: for s1<=R, if closure(Lambda^{B_{s2}}_t) subset B_{s1} for some s2 in [s1,R], then Lambda^{B_s}_t = Lambda^{B_{s2}}_t for all s in [s1,R].
